newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht rallies to 14-yr high offshore.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht rallies to 14-yr high offshore.

text.p: The Thai baht rallied to a new 14-year high against the dollar in the offshore market as foreigners scrambled for the baht to cover short positions, dealers said.
"Liquidity for baht is very tight in the offshore market," said a Singapore-based dealer. "The other way to obtain baht is to sell the (dollar) in the spot market."
The baht moved as high as 22.90 to the dollar in the offshore market in late afternoon trade. At 0901 GMT, the baht eased to 23.050/23.150 against 23.460/23.560 in the early morning.
